description.text:
It's the largest Waitrose branch in the country, and now Waitrose Canary Wharf is packing even more of a punch. Since its refurbishment, the wow-factor has been ramped up with a fresh look, new places to eat and new home and fashion ranges.

At mall level, you'll find everything foodie. From lunch on the move to ingredients for dinner tonight, including fresh meat and fish counters, a bakery and deli, every food desire is catered for.

Our award-winning wine department with temperature-controlled wine room is justly famous - and now you can enjoy any bottle that takes your fancy in the new Wine Bar.

Home-lovers will be in heaven on the ground floor, where you'll find cookware, bedroom and bathroom accessories, toys and gifts. 

And if you fancy accessorising your look, or picking up a shiny new gadget, head to the first floor where you'll find fashion, jewellery, beauty products, electronics and sportswear.

Take some time to relax on our ground floor Waitrose café where you can enjoy hot drinks, breakfast & brunch and hot food.
